title: Generate AI images (1-4 variations, numbered)
description:
Synchronous. Charges **1 credit per image generated** (count=4 → 4
credits). Returns an `image_set` with each image labeled by `number` so
an AI agent can render a numbered thumbnail list for the user to pick
by number.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Image prompt (≤ 2000 chars — concrete visual nouns work best)
fields.placeholder: a wooden ladder leaning against a red brick wall, morning light

fields.name: topic_id
fields.label: topic_id (optional — link to an existing video's asset folder)

use_cases.title: 🖼️ Single portrait image
use_cases.description: One 768×1344 portrait image (Reels/TikTok/Shorts ratio). The default — costs 1 credit.

request.prompt: a wooden ladder leaning against a red brick wall, morning light

use_cases.title: 🎴 4 square variations to pick from
use_cases.description: Generate 4 square variations (4 credits) so the user can pick one. Square ratio is the IG-feed default.

request.prompt: minimalist desk setup with a single houseplant
